en.sayed-ali-raza: We did not name people the arbitrators
but we named the Qur’ān the arbitrator.
The Qur’ān is a book, covered, between two flaps,
It should therefore necessarily have an interpreter.
Men alone can be such interpreters.
When these people invited us to name the Qur’ān as the arbitrator between us, we could not be the party turning away from the Book of Allāh,
since Allāh has said : “. . . And then if ye quarrel about anything refer it to Allāh and the Prophet . . .” (Qur’ān, 4:59)
